fixtures.purpose: mechanical regression fixtures only; not model validation

gate_definitions.1_car_id_permutation_equivariance: A bijective renumbering of car IDs while preserving all semantic PRE fields must only relabel ordered-top3 keys; probabilities must not change.
gate_definitions.2_line_group_id_permutation_invariance: Renaming line-group identifiers while preserving partition membership, positions and sizes must not change model probabilities or synthetic truth.
gate_definitions.3_container_order_invariance: Reordering rider containers without semantic changes must not change model probabilities or synthetic truth.
gate_definitions.4_pre_latent_barrier_regression: PRE objects must not expose or serialize latent_skill.
gate_definitions.5_truth_prediction_code_path_separation: Prediction functions C0/C1/N1 must not call truth generation/scoring functions; architecture core must not import Digital Twin truth code.
gate_definitions.6_no_adaptive_seed_condition_selection_e: Current comparison harness must use fixed CASE_COUNT/WORLDS and deterministic seed/race-index formulas with runtime result-adaptive sampling/retuning disabled.
